overview: FaceAttend is a browser-based facial recognition attendance system for NSQF and JIG students. It uses live camera capture and face-api.js to identify registered individuals and automatically stamp attendance for the correct time slot (entry, break, after-break, or exit) based on the current time. The app includes registration, a full dashboard with attendance records and CSV export, and theme customization.
features: Live face recognition attendance with auto time-slot detection
Student and JIG registration with face capture
Dashboard with attendance records, filters, and CSV export
Motoko backend for face descriptors and attendance records
